description:
Get a Sentry replay's summary and a timeline of what the user did: page loads and navigations, clicks (including dead and rage clicks), inputs and key presses, console warnings and errors, failed requests, and feedback.

USE THIS TOOL WHEN USERS:
- Share a replay URL
- Ask what happened in a replay, or what a user saw and clicked
- Need the moments before an error, a dead click, or the end of a session

<examples>
get_replay_details(replayUrl='https://my-organization.sentry.io/explore/replays/7e07485f-12f9-416b-8b14-26260799b51f/')
get_replay_details(organizationSlug='my-organization', replayId='7e07485f-12f9-416b-8b14-26260799b51f', startOffsetSeconds=-10)
get_replay_details(replayUrl='...', categories=['click', 'network'], startOffsetSeconds=60, endOffsetSeconds=90)
</examples>

<hints>
- Offsets are seconds from the replay start; negative offsets count back from the end, so startOffsetSeconds=-10 shows the last 10 seconds
- The timeline header counts every recorded event, so you can see what to ask for next
</hints>

categories.description: Timeline categories to show. Default: notable events only (navigations, clicks, inputs, console warnings and errors, failed requests, feedback). Naming a category shows all of its events, such as every request for 'network' or every log level for 'console'.

endOffsetSeconds.description: End of the timeline window in seconds from the replay start. Negative values count back from the replay end.

limit.description: Maximum timeline events to return (1-200, default 50).

organizationSlug.description: The organization's slug. You can find a existing list of organizations you have access to using the `find_organizations()` tool.

anyOf.description: The region URL for the organization you're querying, if known. For Sentry's Cloud Service (sentry.io), this is typically the region-specific URL like 'https://us.sentry.io'. For self-hosted Sentry installations, this parameter is usually not needed and should be omitted. You can find the correct regionUrl from the organization details using the `find_organizations()` tool.

replayUrl.description: The URL of the replay. e.g. https://my-organization.sentry.io/explore/replays/7e07485f-12f9-416b-8b14-26260799b51f/

skip.description: Number of matching timeline events to skip. Use the value a previous response gives to continue past the limit.

startOffsetSeconds.description: Start of the timeline window in seconds from the replay start. Negative values count back from the replay end.

name: get_replay_details
title: Get Replay Details
